items.title: The short exact sequence associated to a closed subscheme and its open complement
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the short exact sequence relating a sheaf on X_etale, its extension by zero from the open complement of a closed subscheme and the direct image of its restriction to that closed subscheme (statement lines 11587-11597, with the displayed sequence). The proof builds the two maps from the adjunction properties of the functors (proof lines 11599-11603) and checks exactness on stalks, where the outer terms vanish on complementary loci (proof lines 11603-11609). The non-formal content is the stalk computation. The claim is H2: one construction plus one stalk check.
